text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin! Bakushiiiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (What?! She still has more left in the tank?!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
(However, today's race is 200 meters shorter.
My legs still have plenty left!)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: (I see it, the light—! Just a little more... Just a bit more to get to the other side...!)

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: ! This speed—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when you thought the pace would slacken, it held firm without dropping.
As if in defiance, the tempo quickened even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching footsteps shook the earth violently.
Almost like a roar.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No—this is her cry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faster. Even faster.
Her unquenchable thirst spurs on legs screaming at their limit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is about to leap over it.
That blinding light of top speed she had always dreamed of—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
R-R-REAAAACH OUT!
UUUUUOOOOOAAAAAAARGH!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Ghhghhhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O finishes 1st!!
Calstone Light O claims back-to-back victories
in the Ibis Summer Dash—!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: ...*gasp*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
W-What was that just now...? I couldn't even see it.
All I saw was a flash of light passing by...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
So fast...! That was craaaazy fast!
And the wind! The wind pressure was insaneee!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Is this how Umamusume run...?
I've watched plenty of races, but... I've never experienced anything like this.
I won't forget this for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Niigata Local Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Right O! I bore witness to your top-speed run!
Nobody can catch up to running like that!

text_block_list.name: Niigata Local Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O is the one
who runs at the absolute top speed!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Right O-san!
Splendid... No.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You were so fast!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
That is the highest compliment.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I was rather looking forward to it.
I wondered if, when the time came for you to surpass me,
I too would feel the joy of watching my student grow."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Truly...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Not even a single bit!
I'm not getting sentimental in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's so frustrating! It's just purely and utterly frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I see. But let me make one thing clear.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I have never once thought of you as my master!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"You were the wall standing in the way of top speed.
The presence I must surpass.
In the past, and from now on as well."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
Sounds great, how exciting!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Well then, let us meet again on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yeah. With everything riding on who is fastest.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: What speed...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"By genuinely pursuing pure speed and nothing else,
she reached such incredible swiftness..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: In terms of peak instantaneous speed, Raikou-san is undeniably the fastest. But—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The Sprinters Stakes wouldn't be so easy.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I've been pursuing my own top speed, too.
I have a kind of speed that's different from Right O-san's.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Running worthy of a master artisan, achievable only by perfecting both concentration and elite skill...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I've been honing it all this time.
I won't let anyone take fastest from me...!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for me.
A sharp finishing burst is what makes the fastest runner.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, sharp, and beautiful.
To settle it with a flash of the final drive is a knight's honor.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Who is truly the fastest... The answer will be decided on the track.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting for you, Right O-san.
I'll cut you down
at the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Now all the weight is crashing down onto my legs.
I feel so sluggish. Far too sluggish.
choice_data_list: I'll arrange a massage for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Checking on Calstone Light O's fatigue after the race,
it seemed quite severe.
After putting on a run like that, it was only natural.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She poured every ounce of her strength into pure speed.
It's entirely possible she burned up even more power than she actually had...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The physical limits of an Umamusume.
Her running has already reached that point.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: However, it feels so refreshing. For my hands have finally reached beyond the speed of light.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your voice, Trainer,
giving me that final push for one last step.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Yes. I heard you loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could my voice really be heard above such a massive crowd?
Even so, if it gave her strength, then I am glad.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I must thank Bakushin O as well.
"Calstone Light O-O"
was truly fast!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: In that case, to get even faster, I need more "—"! Tachyon doesn't have an "—" in her name, after all—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Why is that?
choice_data_list: Even without a straightaway, you're fast.
Even without a straightaway, you're fast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Calstone Light O's ability to reach maximum speed
is the result of steady, diligent effort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Basic training, correcting my form...
Even when visible results were hard to see, I kept going without missing a beat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to achieve top speed.
That conviction is the root of everything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to run faster.
As long as she holds that wish in her heart, she will continue to grow faster and faster.
choice_data_list: Calstone Light O is the fastest, you know!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I am the fastest, just as Calstone Light O...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Even without a straight stretch, I am fast!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I feel like I might be able
to break my top speed in the Sprinters Stakes too!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Even over 1200m with corners,
I will exceed maximum speed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Her motivation for the Sprinters Stakes seemed to rise purely by chance,
but let's just say all's well that ends well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If Calstone Light O conquers the Sprinters Stakes, she will truly become the fastest Umamusume in name and in deed!"
